title: Bhutan East-West Highway
slogan: Paro to Trashigang · 275 km home again

waypoints.name: Paro
waypoints.advice: Paro is where the day begins. Next is Thimphu, 83 km on.

waypoints.name: Thimphu
waypoints.advice: Thimphu comes up 83 km in. Next is Dochula Pass, 82 km on.

waypoints.name: Dochula Pass
waypoints.advice: 165 km in you reach Dochula Pass. The road climbs 3100 m over the 82 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 20 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Punakha, 83 km on and mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Punakha
waypoints.advice: Punakha, about halfway. Next is Trongsa, 83 km on.

waypoints.name: Trongsa
waypoints.advice: Trongsa sits at 331 km, about halfway. Next is Bumthang, 82 km on.

waypoints.name: Bumthang
waypoints.advice: Bumthang comes up 413 km in. Next is Trashigang, 83 km on.

sections.advice: Paro → Thimphu is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Thimphu → Dochula Pass climbs about 3100 m in 14 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Dochula Pass → Punakha drops about 3100 m over 22 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Punakha → Trongsa is 78 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Trongsa → Bumthang is 31 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bumthang → Trashigang is 103 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Bhutan East-West Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 51 km this is Bhutan East-West Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bhutan East-West Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3100 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

story: 496 km from Paro to Trashigang, about 6 h 42 of riding. It goes by way of Thimphu, Dochula Pass, Punakha and Trongsa. The highest point is about 4,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
